facts.claim: Primary star is a K2V main-sequence dwarf with 0.38 L☉ luminosity and 5200 K effective temperature.
facts.justification: K-dwarfs provide stable, IR-rich output without the lethal flare sterilization common to M-types, maintaining the required 150–450°C thermal equilibrium. Mass-luminosity relations for ~0.75–0.85 M☉ stars support this output.

facts.claim: Planet orbits at 0.42 AU with a 118-day year and a 43-hour sidereal rotation period.
facts.justification: Keplerian period for a 0.75 M☉ K2V star; explicit sidereal rotation avoids tidal resonance ambiguities and locking. Eccentricity (0.08) drives moderate annual thermal swings.

facts.justification: Volcanic degassing outpaces atmospheric escape; low water activity is mandatory to prevent rapid hydrolysis of Si–O/Si–S bonds. Atmospheric mass scales with surface gravity and escape velocity.
